Released feedback

/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/feedback
Roles: student, instructorScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S09

Read the exact released assessment result, comments and rubric against its received attempt. Staff edits remain hidden until a new release, and earlier release snapshots remain inspectable.

Keep editingSend review request in fixture
Permissions
  • Only released score/comment/rubric payloads enter this page.
  • Group learner sees own applicable released outcome; individual overrides are private.
  • TA may review request only in scoped staff workflow; learner cannot release or edit grades.
  • Instructor entry is an explicitly labeled, read-only learner preview for an authorized selected course member. It does not impersonate the learner or permit review requests, replies, read-state changes or other learner actions.
Responsive
  • On narrow web, work and matching feedback stack with explicit page/question selector.
  • Criterion detail can open a full-width drawer with reading position retained.
Accessibility
  • Annotations have a textual list keyed to page/question.
  • Score and status have spoken labels; history comparisons do not rely only on red/green.
Data
  • Immutable typed result snapshots: reviewed_attempt links receipt/rubric; status_outcome links assessment/person/policy and no fabricated attempt.
  • Released category explanation and linked correction request status; history selector may use releaseId query without requiring an attempt URL.
Acceptance checks (5)
  • An unreleased staff edit never changes displayed score, rubric or comments.
  • Updated feedback preserves the earlier released payload in history.
  • A failed review request remains unsent and cannot change score or deadline.
  • Clarification failure retains unsent text; success updates the existing W54 request, never posts a discussion reply or changes the released grade.
  • A released Missing/Excused result can open feedback without an attemptId or receipt; no numeric/page content is invented. A policy-only course-total change opens W24 instead.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
